items.definition:
Powdered green tea
She enjoys a warm cup of matcha every morning.

Small carnivorous mammal
The mongoose is known for its ability to fight snakes.

A tropical fruit resembling a banana, eaten cooked.
We had fried plantain with our dinner.

A child who is not yet old enough to attend school.
My youngest child is a preschooler.

A person who signs, especially one who uses sign language.
The deaf community relies on a skilled signer for communication.

A dense growth of shrubs and other plants, especially under trees in woodland.
We pushed our way through the thick undergrowth.

a type of squash or tree
We roasted the butternut squash for dinner.

a sharp, ringing sound
We heard the clank of chains in the distance.

a breed of dog with a white coat and black spots
The dalmatian ran quickly across the park.

a room where photographic film is processed
He spent hours developing photos in his darkroom.

a game in which players try to hit opponents with a ball while avoiding being hit themselves
We played a lively game of dodgeball during recess.

the modern Persian language
Farsi is the official language of Iran.

a trivial or minor lie
He told a little fib about why he was late.

a name given to a computer file
Please choose a descriptive filename for your document.

tombstone, headstone
The old gravestone in the cemetery was covered in moss.

suspension; execution by rope
The hanging of the new curtains transformed the room.

person buying a house
The market is currently favorable for first-time homebuyers.

a large long-handled spoon
She used a ladle to serve the soup.

a place with coin-operated washing machines
I need to go to the laundromat to wash my clothes.

a broadcast of news on radio or television
The evening newscast reported on the local elections.

A common painkiller
I took some paracetamol for my headache.

The act of choosing or gathering
Fruit picking is a popular activity in the summer.

A small book or a handbag
She carried her keys and phone in her pocketbook.

A type of seabird with a large, brightly colored beak
We saw a puffin nesting on the cliffs.

finely cut cabbage that has been fermented
Sauerkraut is a traditional German side dish.

a rigid support used to keep a broken bone or injured part of the body in the correct position
The doctor put a splint on his broken arm.

a very large store, typically selling a wide range of goods
We bought all our groceries at the new superstore.

a small cart with one wheel at the front and two handles at the back
He pushed the soil in a wheelbarrow.

a type of coffee drink
I'd like a large americano with a splash of milk, please.

a swimming stroke performed on the back
She prefers swimming the backstroke to the freestyle.

a long bar with weights at each end, used for weightlifting
He lifted the barbell with ease during his workout.

A part of a cooker that cooks food by direct heat from above; a young chicken suitable for broiling.
Put the chicken under the broiler for five minutes to crisp the skin.

A continuous rattling sound.
The dishes fell to the floor with a loud clatter.

Good sense and sound judgment in practical matters.
It's just commonsense to look both ways before crossing the street.

a device for fastening the cuffs of a shirt
He wore elegant cufflinks with his suit.

a mat placed at the entrance of a door for wiping shoes
Please wipe your feet on the doormat.

a type of sausage; a person from Frankfurt
He ordered a frankfurter with mustard.

a unit of information equal to one billion bytes
My phone has 128 gigabytes of storage.

a piece of cloth worn on the head
She wore a colorful headscarf to protect her hair.

a person who makes, sells, or repairs jewelry
She took her watch to the jeweller for repair.

wood from a pine tree
The furniture was made from light pinewood.

A ray of sunlight.
A single sunbeam pierced through the clouds.

A vacuum flask for keeping liquids hot or cold.
I poured hot coffee into my thermos for the trip.

the land along the edge of a body of water
They enjoyed a picnic by the waterside.

a device for connecting parts of different sizes or types
I need an adaptor to plug my laptop into the European outlet.

a cosmetic product used to give the skin a tanned look
She applied bronzer to her cheeks for a sun-kissed glow.

the quality or state of being cold
The coldness of the winter air made her shiver.

a flat surface for working on, especially in a kitchen
She wiped down the kitchen countertop after cooking.

a short-legged, long-bodied breed of dog
Her pet dachshund loved to chase squirrels.

a Middle Eastern dish of spiced mashed chickpeas or fava beans formed into balls or fritters and deep-fried
I ordered a falafel wrap for lunch.

the day on which a sports game is played
Fans gathered early for game-day festivities.

the business or skill of cutting and styling hair
She decided to pursue a career in hairdressing.

a very short time
I'll be with you in a jiffy.

outdoor toilet
In the countryside, some old farms still have an outhouse.

baby's dummy
The baby stopped crying when given a pacifier.

a type of backpack
He packed his rucksack for the hiking trip.

the part of a town or resort that faces the sea
We enjoyed a walk along the seafront.

a frozen dessert made from sweetened water flavored with fruit or other ingredients
For dessert, we had a refreshing lemon sorbet.

a tool or device for spreading something
He used a butter spreader for his toast.

a device used for separating liquid from solid
She used a strainer to drain the pasta.

A device or person that winds
The clock winder needed to be replaced.

A person from Angola
The Angolan community celebrated their national holiday.

a native or inhabitant of Cameroon
The Cameroonian ambassador addressed the assembly.

a book of blank checks
She wrote a check from her checkbook to pay the bill.
